records.rationale: Retain -mllvm -trap-unreachable and -mllvm -no-trap-after-noreturn on final Clang generation of linked Rust/helper bitcode. Without these, changing code generation from rustc to Clang can lose rustc unreachable traps and expose fallthrough into another function or section. Both flags appear in the actual saved SDK kernel Rust compile command. Native LTS -Zunstable-options and objtool processing remain. This is a security-relevant companion fix for the chosen inlining mode, not a diagnostic-warning suppression.
